notes: Expanded after dedicated Xenoverse 2 pages confirmed Giant Storm as a 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate and Gigantic Slam as a 100-Ki Strike Super. Giant Storm is CaC-usable through the Skill Shop; Gigantic Slam remains cast-exclusive. Removed duplicate Bloody Sauce identity; retained its earlier canonical research/correction chain. Gigantic Slam was added after dedicated-source verification: its page explicitly identifies it as a Strike Super, 100 Ki, and unavailable to CaC.
